'''Ra-Lee''' was a fish spirit in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology who lulled fishers to sleep and ate their bait. "Ra-Lee" was a popular name given to female Ewoks,<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Ra-Lee|the mother]] of [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]] and [[Asha/Legends|Asha]].<ref name="Asha (episode)">{{Ewoks|Asha (episode)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ra-Lee was first mentioned in the roleplaying game ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'' in [[2003]].<ref name="GCG" />
